title: Return of the Bumblebee
author: Majrooh Rashid
text:
The bumblebee
came all the way
from the inmost of the hinterland,
flitting from briar banks
of mountain brooks
to rose blooms
and ultimately settled
on the lively marigolds,
in full bloom, in this garden,
maintaining its perennial mystique.
Wrapping them with its magic charmed wings, it felt satiated,
as if showers had lashed parched lands.
The butterflies around sensed
something great was happening,
clustered around them,
and made their presence felt in a big way.
